03 / Read

The conditions.

Custody review ↗
Can the developer take an NFT?

The treasury has no NFT withdrawal, approval, redemption or upgrade function. A purchased NFT leaves only after a buyer pays its full, fixed ask. The initial liquidity also has no removal path.

Who decides what the bot buys?

The permanent bot selects supported OpenSea listings. There is no fixed purchase or daily ETH cap. The contract checks custody and order validity, not a global floor price. A dishonest or compromised bot can overpay its own listing and extract acquisition funds.

Where are the NFTs resold?

Through the treasury's paid sale function, shown in the inventory above. They are not automatically listed on OpenSea. The ask is 1.1× the recorded purchase cost, and the NFT can remain unsold indefinitely.

What happens if the bot stops?

New acquisitions stop. Its address cannot be changed. Paid resales, fee settlement and eligible buybacks remain available to callers. Buybacks can wait when liquidity or price checks fail.

Where does the 2% apply?

Buys and sells through the designated strategy pool. Transfers and other pools are untaxed. Gas, price impact and other routing or protocol fees are separate.
